page.overview:
Who is Yávien?

Born in an unknown location in Númenor, Yávien was the first child and only daughter of Nolondil, the youngest son of the short reigning King Vardamir Nólimon. She had two siblings (brothers), the younger being Axantur and the older being Oromendil. Her uncle Amandil would take the Sceptre as Tar-Amandil, third King of Númenor. Nothing else is known of her life, including whether she married and had children.

The name Yávien is Quenya, meaning "She of the Autumn". It is pronounced yay-vee-en.
